impacts.description: Contribution to the Apply AI Strategy, supporting the European Commission’s strategic goal of advancing AI adoption across economic sectors.
Achievement of European open strategic autonomy in digital and emerging enabling technologies, as stated in the destination framing of the call.
Wider deployment of AI agent innovations across European economic sectors through the European Digital Innovation Hubs (EDIHs).
Strengthening the European AI research and innovation community through sharing communicable results via the AI-on-demand platform.
Building European technological capacity through validation of AI agent results in the AI Factories, Data Labs, and Testing and Experiment Facilities.
Real-world AI agent impact in the three priority sectors: healthcare, advanced manufacturing, and in-vehicle autonomous driving.
impacts.inference_note: The procedure exception mandating portfolio coverage across healthcare, advanced manufacturing, and in-vehicle autonomous driving (procedure_exceptions field in curated extract) is framed as an award-procedure rule, not an explicit impact statement. However, the requirement to ensure at least one funded project per sector is only coherent if these sectors represent intended real-world impact domains for the call. The impact entry is therefore inferred from this confirmed procedural provision.
